about.title: The problem matters more than the interface.
about.body:
I've spent 10+ years designing digital products, and what interests me most isn't the interface—it's understanding the problem, making better decisions, and turning real needs into product solutions.

I've led product initiatives at Compensar, Scotiabank Colpatria, and ADL Digital Lab, across fintech, health, real estate, and services.

My approach integrates product strategy, multidisciplinary leadership, and technical execution, including Design Systems, applied AI, and front-end development.

I connect business, technology, and experience to make evidence-based decisions, optimize processes, and build scalable digital products.

approach.title: Design as a decision system.
approach.body:
I turn complex problems into clear product decisions, using research, evidence, and shared goals to build scalable solutions.

I integrate AI as a design process accelerator: research, synthesis, ideation, documentation, and QA — always with human judgment and product vision.

My leadership connects business, design, and engineering from early stages, reducing rework, accelerating decisions, and elevating product quality.
